title: Web need: import an .asd or .alc onto a Library sample with a dry-run report
description:
## Need (for the web/docs session; not visuals)
A person working in the web app should be able to drop an `.asd` or `.alc` onto a sample in the Library, see the same dry-run report the CLI prints (what moves, by how much), confirm, and later reset to the analysis grid.

## Data the UI needs
An import endpoint on `apricity serve` taking the file bytes and a sample id, with `dryRun`, returning the report lines and errors with location (same texts as the CLI), and a reset call. Writes go through the same domain op as the CLI.

## Out of scope
Visual design.

## Verify
The web session files its UI tasks from this; done when the endpoint exists with a test in `crates/apricity-cli/tests` calling it over HTTP.
